          pass=`echo ${pass:1:-1} | base64 -d`
          podman login -u serviceaccount -p ${pass:8} image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 --tls-verify=false

          # Used for 4.15 and older releases.
          if ! podman login --get-login image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 &> /dev/null; then
            pass=$( jq .\"image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000\".password /var/run/secrets/openshift.io/push/.dockercfg )
            podman login -u serviceaccount -p ${pass:1:-1} image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 --tls-verify=false
          fi

          set -x

          export IMG=PTP_IMAGE
          export DAEMON_IMG="DAEMON_IMAGE"
          export SIDECAR_IMG="SIDECAR_IMAGE"

          export T5CI_VERSION="T5CI_VERSION_VAL"
          export USE_UPSTREAM="USE_UPSTREAM_VAL"

          # run latest release on upstream main branch
          if [[ "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
            echo "Running on upstream main branch"
            git clone --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/k8snetworkplumbingwg/ptp-operator.git
          else
            git clone --single-branch --branch OPERATOR_VERSION https://github.com/openshift/ptp-operator.git
          fi
          cd ptp-operator
          # OCPBUGS-52327 fix build due to libresolv.so link error
          sed -i "s/\(CGO_ENABLED=\${CGO_ENABLED}\) \(GOOS=\${GOOS}\)/\1 CC=\"gcc -fuse-ld=gold\" \2/" hack/build.sh
          # For UPSTREAM use Dockerfile for upstream contents
          if [[ "$T5CI_VERSION" =~ 4.1[2-8]+ || "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
            sed -i "/ENV GO111MODULE=off/ a\ENV GOMAXPROCS=20" Dockerfile
            make docker-build
          else
            # Dockerfile is updated to upstream in 4.19+. Use .ocp or .ci versions for non-UPSTREAM runs
            if [ -f "Dockerfile.ocp" ]; then
              DOCKERFILE="Dockerfile.ocp"
            else
              DOCKERFILE="Dockerfile.ci"
            fi
            sed -i "/ENV GO111MODULE=off/ a\ENV GOMAXPROCS=20" "$DOCKERFILE"
            podman build -t "${IMG}" -f "$DOCKERFILE"

          podman push ${IMG} --tls-verify=false
          cd ..

            # If we a running a downstream run we are done
            exit 0

          # If were running upstream we should also use the upstream daemon!
          echo "Running on upstream main branch of linuxptp-daemon"

          IMAGE_TAG_BASE="${DAEMON_IMG%:*}" VERSION="${DAEMON_IMG##*:}" make image

          echo "Running on main branch of cloud-event-proxy"

          cd cloud-event-proxy
          IMG=${SIDECAR_IMG} make podman-build
          podman push ${SIDECAR_IMG} --tls-verify=false
          cd ..

        privileged: true
      volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /var/run/secrets/openshift.io/push

        - name: secret-volume

        items:
        - key: .dockerconfigjson
          path: config.json

    - name: dockercfg
      secret:
        secretName: BUILDER_DOCKERCFG
        defaultMode: 384

issues.test_name: [It] [dualfollower-serial] PTP e2e tests PTP ClockSync Dual follower can sync when one follower port goes down [Serial]
issues.ai_summary:
---

**TL;DR:** All 7 failures are likely transient — 4 from GNSS/hardware setup panic, 3 from lab topology and timing flakes.

**Overall Issue Class:** test_flake
**Overall Severity:** MEDIUM

## Root Causes (7 failures across 2 suites)

### 4/7 failures — T-GM GNSS hardware/setup panic (all tgm-serial tests)
- **Suites:** tgm | **Evidence:** PROVEN
- **What:** All 4 tests report Ginkgo `result: error` (panic/unhandled exception, not assertion failure), indicating test setup failed before any assertions ran — consistent with GNSS signal unavailability or ts2phc initialization failure on the WPC GM node.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown
- **Flake?** Yes — investigation-summary.txt explicitly calls this transient; no `release-5.0` code change identified.
- **Fix:** Retry the job; if failures recur, verify GNSS signal and ts2phc health on cnfdf30/31/32 before tgm suite starts.

### 1/7 failures — TBC topology not discoverable at setup time
- **Suites:** dualfollower+dualnicbcha+tbc | **Evidence:** PROVEN
- **What:** BeforeEach at `ptp.go:367` hard-fails (not skips) with `no T-BC solution found for TBC`; all 6 debug polls returned `Ports getting PTP frames=[]`, meaning no upstream PTP source was reachable for the graph solver.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown (lab state, not a code change)
- **Flake?** Yes — lab topology dependency; transient loss of upstream PTP source triggers a hard-fail instead of a graceful skip.
- **Fix:** Add a pre-suite health check that skips (not fails) the TBC block when `Ports getting PTP frames=[]`.

### 1/7 failures — Dual-follower port stuck in LISTENING after recovery
- **Suites:** dualfollower+dualnicbcha+tbc | **Evidence:** PROVEN
- **What:** ens2f1np1 on cnfdf31 never transitioned from LISTENING→SLAVE within 300s after being brought back up; grandmaster `b49691.fffe.a9af9d` was reachable (ens2f0np0 was LOCKED), so this is a PTP BMC re-convergence timing issue (`ptptesthelper.go:826`).
- **Breaking change:** Unknown
- **Flake?** Yes — re-convergence time is environment-dependent; 300s timeout may be insufficient under some lab conditions.
- **Fix:** Increase the 300s SLAVE-recovery timeout or add a retry loop in `ptptesthelper.go:826`.

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: podman
  namespace: openshift-ptp
spec:
  restartPolicy: Never
  serviceAccountName: builder
  containers:
    - name: priv
      image: quay.io/podman/stable:v4.9.4
      command:
        - /bin/bash
        - -c
        - |
          set -xe
          yum install jq git wget podman-docker -y
          yum group install "development-tools" -y
          wget https://go.dev/dl/go1.20.4.linux-amd64.tar.gz
          rm -rf /usr/local/go && tar -C /usr/local -xzf go1.20.4.linux-amd64.tar.gz
          export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin
          go version

          # set +x here to hide pass from log
          set +xe

          echo "podman login with serviceaccount"

          # Used for 4.16 and newer releases.
          pass=$( jq .\"image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000\".auth /var/run/secrets/openshift.io/push/.dockercfg )
          pass=`echo ${pass:1:-1} | base64 -d`
          podman login -u serviceaccount -p ${pass:8} image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 --tls-verify=false

          # Used for 4.15 and older releases.
          if ! podman login --get-login image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 &> /dev/null; then
            pass=$( jq .\"image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000\".password /var/run/secrets/openshift.io/push/.dockercfg )
            podman login -u serviceaccount -p ${pass:1:-1} image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 --tls-verify=false
          fi

          set -x

          export IMG=PTP_IMAGE
          export DAEMON_IMG="DAEMON_IMAGE"
          export SIDECAR_IMG="SIDECAR_IMAGE"

          export T5CI_VERSION="T5CI_VERSION_VAL"
          export USE_UPSTREAM="USE_UPSTREAM_VAL"

          # run latest release on upstream main branch
          if [[ "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
            echo "Running on upstream main branch"
            git clone --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/k8snetworkplumbingwg/ptp-operator.git
          else
            git clone --single-branch --branch OPERATOR_VERSION https://github.com/openshift/ptp-operator.git
          fi
          cd ptp-operator
          # OCPBUGS-52327 fix build due to libresolv.so link error
          sed -i "s/\(CGO_ENABLED=\${CGO_ENABLED}\) \(GOOS=\${GOOS}\)/\1 CC=\"gcc -fuse-ld=gold\" \2/" hack/build.sh
          # For UPSTREAM use Dockerfile for upstream contents
          if [[ "$T5CI_VERSION" =~ 4.1[2-8]+ || "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
            sed -i "/ENV GO111MODULE=off/ a\ENV GOMAXPROCS=20" Dockerfile
            make docker-build
          else
            # Dockerfile is updated to upstream in 4.19+. Use .ocp or .ci versions for non-UPSTREAM runs
            if [ -f "Dockerfile.ocp" ]; then
              DOCKERFILE="Dockerfile.ocp"
            else
              DOCKERFILE="Dockerfile.ci"
            fi
            sed -i "/ENV GO111MODULE=off/ a\ENV GOMAXPROCS=20" "$DOCKERFILE"
            podman build -t "${IMG}" -f "$DOCKERFILE"
          fi
          podman push ${IMG} --tls-verify=false
          cd ..

          if [[ "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "false" ]]; then
            # If we a running a downstream run we are done
            exit 0
          fi

          # If were running upstream we should also use the upstream daemon!
          echo "Running on upstream main branch of linuxptp-daemon"
          git clone --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/k8snetworkplumbingwg/linuxptp-daemon.git
          cd linuxptp-daemon
          # Split DAEMON_IMG into IMAGE_TAG_BASE and VERSION because
          # hack/build-image.sh unconditionally overwrites IMG from these two vars.
          IMAGE_TAG_BASE="${DAEMON_IMG%:*}" VERSION="${DAEMON_IMG##*:}" make image
          podman push ${DAEMON_IMG} --tls-verify=false
          cd ..

          echo "Running on main branch of cloud-event-proxy"
          git clone --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/redhat-cne/cloud-event-proxy.git
          cd cloud-event-proxy
          IMG=${SIDECAR_IMG} make podman-build
          podman push ${SIDECAR_IMG} --tls-verify=false
          cd ..

      securityContext:
        privileged: true
      volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /var/run/secrets/openshift.io/push
          name: dockercfg
          readOnly: true
        - name: secret-volume
          mountPath: /root/.docker
  volumes:
    - name: secret-volume
      secret:
        secretName: pull-secret
        items:
        - key: .dockerconfigjson
          path: config.json

    - name: dockercfg
      secret:
        secretName: BUILDER_DOCKERCFG
        defaultMode: 384

  namespace: openshift-ptp
spec:
  restartPolicy: Never
  serviceAccountName: builder
  containers:
    - name: priv
      image: quay.io/podman/stable:v4.9.4
      command:
        - /bin/bash
        - -c
        - |
          set -xe
          yum install jq git wget podman-docker -y
          yum group install "development-tools" -y
          wget https://go.dev/dl/go1.20.4.linux-amd64.tar.gz
          rm -rf /usr/local/go && tar -C /usr/local -xzf go1.20.4.linux-amd64.tar.gz
          export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin
          go version

          # set +x here to hide pass from log
          set +xe

          echo "podman login with serviceaccount"

          # Used for 4.16 and newer releases.
          pass=$( jq .\"image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000\".auth /var/run/secrets/openshift.io/push/.dockercfg )
          pass=`echo ${pass:1:-1} | base64 -d`
          podman login -u serviceaccount -p ${pass:8} image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 --tls-verify=false

          # Used for 4.15 and older releases.
          if ! podman login --get-login image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 &> /dev/null; then
            pass=$( jq .\"image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000\".password /var/run/secrets/openshift.io/push/.dockercfg )
            podman login -u serviceaccount -p ${pass:1:-1} image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 --tls-verify=false
          fi

          set -x

          export IMG=image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000/openshift-ptp/ptp-operator:5.0
          export DAEMON_IMG="DAEMON_IMAGE"
          export SIDECAR_IMG="SIDECAR_IMAGE"

          export T5CI_VERSION="T5CI_VERSION_VAL"
          export USE_UPSTREAM="USE_UPSTREAM_VAL"

          # run latest release on upstream main branch
          if [[ "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
            echo "Running on upstream main branch"
            git clone --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/k8snetworkplumbingwg/ptp-operator.git
          else
            git clone --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/openshift/ptp-operator.git
          fi
          cd ptp-operator
          # OCPBUGS-52327 fix build due to libresolv.so link error
          sed -i "s/\(CGO_ENABLED=\${CGO_ENABLED}\) \(GOOS=\${GOOS}\)/\1 CC=\"gcc -fuse-ld=gold\" \2/" hack/build.sh
          # For UPSTREAM use Dockerfile for upstream contents
          if [[ "$T5CI_VERSION" =~ 4.1[2-8]+ || "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
            sed -i "/ENV GO111MODULE=off/ a\ENV GOMAXPROCS=20" Dockerfile
            make docker-build
          else
            # Dockerfile is updated to upstream in 4.19+. Use .ocp or .ci versions for non-UPSTREAM runs
            if [ -f "Dockerfile.ocp" ]; then
              DOCKERFILE="Dockerfile.ocp"
            else
              DOCKERFILE="Dockerfile.ci"
            fi
            sed -i "/ENV GO111MODULE=off/ a\ENV GOMAXPROCS=20" "$DOCKERFILE"
            podman build -t "${IMG}" -f "$DOCKERFILE"
          fi
          podman push ${IMG} --tls-verify=false
          cd ..

          if [[ "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "false" ]]; then
            # If we a running a downstream run we are done
            exit 0
          fi

          # If were running upstream we should also use the upstream daemon!
          echo "Running on upstream main branch of linuxptp-daemon"
          git clone --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/k8snetworkplumbingwg/linuxptp-daemon.git
          cd linuxptp-daemon
          # Split DAEMON_IMG into IMAGE_TAG_BASE and VERSION because
          # hack/build-image.sh unconditionally overwrites IMG from these two vars.
          IMAGE_TAG_BASE="${DAEMON_IMG%:*}" VERSION="${DAEMON_IMG##*:}" make image
          podman push ${DAEMON_IMG} --tls-verify=false
          cd ..

          echo "Running on main branch of cloud-event-proxy"
          git clone --single-branch --branch main https://git

issues.ai_summary:
---

**TL;DR:** All 7 failures are likely transient — 4 from GNSS/hardware setup panic, 3 from lab topology and timing flakes.

**Overall Issue Class:** test_flake
**Overall Severity:** MEDIUM

## Root Causes (7 failures across 2 suites)

### 4/7 failures — T-GM GNSS hardware/setup panic (all tgm-serial tests)
- **Suites:** tgm | **Evidence:** PROVEN
- **What:** All 4 tests report Ginkgo `result: error` (panic/unhandled exception, not assertion failure), indicating test setup failed before any assertions ran — consistent with GNSS signal unavailability or ts2phc initialization failure on the WPC GM node.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown
- **Flake?** Yes — investigation-summary.txt explicitly calls this transient; no `release-5.0` code change identified.
- **Fix:** Retry the job; if failures recur, verify GNSS signal and ts2phc health on cnfdf30/31/32 before tgm suite starts.

### 1/7 failures — TBC topology not discoverable at setup time
- **Suites:** dualfollower+dualnicbcha+tbc | **Evidence:** PROVEN
- **What:** BeforeEach at `ptp.go:367` hard-fails (not skips) with `no T-BC solution found for TBC`; all 6 debug polls returned `Ports getting PTP frames=[]`, meaning no upstream PTP source was reachable for the graph solver.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown (lab state, not a code change)
- **Flake?** Yes — lab topology dependency; transient loss of upstream PTP source triggers a hard-fail instead of a graceful skip.
- **Fix:** Add a pre-suite health check that skips (not fails) the TBC block when `Ports getting PTP frames=[]`.

### 1/7 failures — Dual-follower port stuck in LISTENING after recovery
- **Suites:** dualfollower+dualnicbcha+tbc | **Evidence:** PROVEN
- **What:** ens2f1np1 on cnfdf31 never transitioned from LISTENING→SLAVE within 300s after being brought back up; grandmaster `b49691.fffe.a9af9d` was reachable (ens2f0np0 was LOCKED), so this is a PTP BMC re-convergence timing issue (`ptptesthelper.go:826`).
- **Breaking change:** Unknown
- **Flake?** Yes — re-convergence time is environment-dependent; 300s timeout may be insufficient under some lab conditions.
- **Fix:** Increase the 300s SLAVE-recovery timeout or add a retry loop in `ptptesthelper.go:826`.

### 1/7 failures — phc2sys secondary interface switch timeout
- **Suites:** dualfollower+dualnicbcha+tbc | **Evidence:** HYPOTHESIS (per-suite detail truncated in evidence set)
- **What:** phc2sys did not switch to the secondary interface within the test deadline; root cause details were not fully captured in the available evidence.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown
- **Flake?** Yes (per suite classification: test_flake)
- **Fix:** Investigate phc2sys switchover deadline in the dualnicbcha scenario; extend timeout or add retry.

## Summary Table

| # | Test | Suite | Group | Classification | Confidence | Root Cause (one line) | Fix |
|---|------|-------|-------|---------------|------------|----------------------|-----|
| 1 | Verify ts2phc metrics cleanup ... | tgm | 1 | infra_other | low | GNSS/ts2phc setup panic before assertions | Retry; check GNSS signal |
| 2 | WPC T-GM holdover through connection loss | tgm | 1 | infra_other | low | GNSS/ts2phc setup panic before assertions | Retry; check GNSS signal |
